tool_args.rationale: The archive identifies a coupled memory ODE whose latent initial state must be reconstructed from the irregular raw prefix. Its four parameters require at least eight rows; the five pilot observations leave genuine identifiability ambiguity. The trajectory batch supplies the relevant additional observations.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory ODE using the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The four coupled parameters and reconstructed latent memory are not adequately identified by five correlated observations.
The observed history dependence and coupled transient lag point to the memory ODE rather than a static sink-gradient branch.
It does not address the identified ambiguity.
